name: Domain Access Logo
description: Module to create separate logos for each domain
project_description:
This module provides uploading different logos for (sub)domains created using the Domain module.

 Configuration: 
 Configuration for uploading a logo for each (sub)domain: admin/config/domain/domain_access_logo 

 Dependencies: 
 
 Domain 
 
 Similar Modules: 
 
 Domain Site Logo provides the administrator interface to manage the site logo setting for each domain. Has an extra dependency on Domain Site Settings . 
 Domain Access Unique Logo allows the administrator to upload unique logo while creating/editing each domain.
